topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I can't sit still, you know? These flowers, they’re just sitting there, mocking me with their silence. Who would do this? Send something so beautiful and not even a note? I mean, it’s not like I can’t guess who it might be, but the not knowing is driving me crazy. I’ve been staring at them for the longest time, trying to read them, to find the hidden message in the way the petals curve or the color they chose. Do you think it’s some kind of sign? I keep looking at them, hoping they’ll suddenly bloom into a clue or something. Maybe I’m overthinking it, but I can’t help it. It’s late, and I should sleep, but... I just can’t.
